news.headline: BlackRock discloses 7.1% beneficial stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: A Schedule 13G/A filing shows BlackRock has accumulated a 7.1% passive beneficial ownership stake in ClearPoint Neuro, adding a large institutional holder alongside existing investors like MAK Capital and Bigger Capital.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.source: The Globe and Mail / ACCESS Newswire
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on August 3, 2026, followed by a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro CEO Burnett sells $387,600 in company shares
news.summary: A Form 4 filing disclosed that CEO Joseph Burnett exercised options and sold approximately $387,600 worth of ClearPoint Neuro common stock in early July 2026 under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, coinciding with a pullback in the shares that day.

news.headline: B. Riley raises ClearPoint Neuro price target to $30 from $20, keeps Buy
news.summary: B. Riley analyst Anderson Schock raised his price target on ClearPoint Neuro to $30 from $20 while reiterating a Buy rating, citing the platform-validating implications of the FDA's stance on partner uniQure's AMT-130 program.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro shares surge as FDA clears accelerated-approval path for partner uniQure's AMT-130
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro shares jumped roughly 26-32% after partner uniQure disclosed that an FDA Type B meeting confirmed its three-year Phase I/II data can support a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, with submission planned for Q3 2026; AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula.

news.headline: Stifel reiterates ClearPoint Neuro Buy rating, $16 price target after ASSFN meeting
news.summary: Stifel reiterated its Buy rating and $16 price target on ClearPoint Neuro following the biennial American Society for Stereotactic and Functional Neurosurgery (ASSFN) meeting, citing continued traction for the company's neurosurgical navigation platform.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro reports second-quarter 2026 results after market close with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET; investors will watch for progress toward full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $52M-$56M and updated commentary on the uniQure AMT-130 opportunity.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission for Huntington's disease
catalysts.detail: Following an FDA Type B meeting confirming that three-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA, partner uniQure plans to submit the filing in Q3 2026. AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, making regulatory progress here a direct validation of ClearPoint's delivery-device business.

catalysts.label: Other partner pipeline milestones
catalysts.detail: Beyond uniQure, ClearPoint's device/navigation revenue is tied to a broad roster of 60+ biopharma partners' gene- and cell-therapy programs that use its SmartFlow and navigation systems; regulatory or clinical progress at these partners remains a recurring catalyst for ClearPoint's per-case and IRRAflow revenue.

catalysts.label: Continued Velocity Alpha and international rollout
catalysts.detail: Following FDA clearance and first clinical use of the Velocity Alpha MR surgical drill system earlier in 2026, further commercial rollout, IRRAS/IRRAflow integration, and international regulatory clearances remain an ongoing growth driver.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro heads into its August 3, 2026 Q2 print riding a major positive catalyst: partner uniQure's June 17 disclosure that the FDA will accept three-year AMT-130 Huntington's data for an accelerated-approval BLA (planned Q3 2026 submission), which sent CLPT shares up roughly 30% and drove a price-target hike from B. Riley to $30. The stock has since pulled back into the mid-teens amid a routine 10b5-1 CEO share sale and broader profit-taking, even as BlackRock's late-July Schedule 13G/A disclosed a fresh 7.1% passive stake, adding a large new institutional holder. The core thesis remains ClearPoint's role as the neuro-navigation and delivery-device partner across 60+ biopharma gene- and cell-therapy programs, with uniQure's regulatory progress now the clearest near-term proof point for that platform value ahead of Monday's earnings.
